event.dorian_heart2.4.text: There's another place. Deeper in. Not yet. Some ground you ask first. I'll ask.
event.dorian_heart2.4.why: too-exact care: he asks the ground

event.dorian_heart2.4.text: There's another place. Deeper in. Not yet. The moss is deciding. The whole wood is careful lately.

event.dorian_heart5.0.text: Step over the root. Not on the moss. ...Breathe. This spot is kind. That's why I keep it.
event.dorian_heart5.0.why: gentler at fear; 'keep' carries the second meaning

event.dorian_heart5.1.text: I've never shown anyone. Edmund found it alone. I didn't mind. I should have.

event.dorian_heart5.3.text: He was counting the trees. He got to forty-one. ...Count slower than he did.
event.dorian_heart5.3.why: clue tier: the canon forty-one, covered as advice

event.reading_night.2.text: A snowdrop. Pressed since winter. It kept my place. Now it keeps the lamp. The lamp earns it, nights like this.
event.reading_night.2.why: keeps Ione's snowdrop-and-lamp echo; adds the night

event.story_notes_dorian.after.text: Three more doors before dark. Before dark matters. Don't follow. Don't guess.
event.story_notes_dorian.after.why: the exactness tell: he repeats the deadline

dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.1.text: Mine just stands there. Silent. Crows hate silence. Fewer crows this fall. I counted.
dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.1.why: birds-quieter ladder; counting is my tell

event.story_pumpkin_dorian.intro.text: ...The inside was the right dark. Safe dark. For spores. Asking needed words. I ran out.
event.story_pumpkin_dorian.intro.why: he grades darkness; same confession, same joke

event.dorian_heart8.intro.text: Sit. The log. ...You look tired. Good. Sitting fixes that. I practiced this part. Don't speak yet.

dlg.dorian.notebook.1.text: Mushrooms. Four hundred and twelve. Drawn. Three pages stay shut. Don't ask. ...Be gentle.
dlg.dorian.notebook.1.why: clue: something is kept; count canon untouched

event.dorian_birthday.intro.text: ...My birthday. Marcus told the whole saloon. The trees won't mention it. You look worn. Stay a minute. That helps us both.
event.dorian_birthday.intro.why: his birthday, and he tends the player

event.dorian_courtship.intro.text: ...I practiced this since spring. The trees heard it first. You're safe here. Will you court me? Slowly. Quietly.
event.dorian_courtship.intro.why: a frightened player hears safety before the question

dlg.dorian.partners.r1.text: The forest, then. Past the third tree. Never past the gate. The oak listens.
dlg.dorian.partners.r1.why: revelation gate: the boundary he keeps, unexplained

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_1.l2.text: Straight. Like a birch. The birches lean, lately.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_1.l2.why: ladder item between two Keepers, under 20 words

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l2.text: Oak. Good. Heavy. Some nights a door should be heavy.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l2.why: full: the weight is the point

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l2.text: Oak. Good. First door I'd close on purpose. Some nights, firmly.

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_4.l2.text: ...Toward the trees? Good. I'd rather see them than not.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_4.l2.why: the watch window; Marcus's owl line still lands

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_1.l3.text: ...Quiet today. The jays left early. I counted them out.
event.overheard_dorian_hazel_1.l3.why: counting aloud where the pattern-spotter can hear

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_2.l1.why: clue: Edmund kept; 'pressed leaves' hinge intact

threads.dorian_heart2: Why does the forager set a before-dark rule, new moons especially, on his own wood?
threads.dorian_heart5: Edmund was counting trees toward something, and Dorian knows exactly how far he got.
threads.reading_night: Who checks the dark before a reading night, and against what?

threads.story_pumpkin_dorian: Why does a forager grade darkness into safe and otherwise?
threads.dorian_heart8: Three pages of the notebook stay shut; what grows where he will not show?

threads.dorian_courtship: Why does his proposal begin by promising the player is safe?
threads.dorian_courtship2: He is very practiced at waiting; what else has he waited years on?
threads.dorian_partners: There is a gate in the wood he will not pass, even on their first day together.
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_1: Two quiet men checking whether the trees still stand true.
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_2: What do the village's two quietest men listen for through an hour of silence?
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_3: Why would the man who leaves doors open want one heavy enough to close?
